vibe: Anime Vibes with HipHop Urban flows

layout.grid_system: Bento 'Tetris' Grid (Mode A) with asymmetric spans
layout.corners: rounded-none for brutalist cards, rounded-full for pills/buttons
layout.borders: 1px solid border-border with intense shadow offsets on hover

components.buttons: Solid primary color, black text, brutalist hover effect (-translate-y-1, brutalist box shadow), never generic pill.
components.cards: Glassmorphism 2.0 (backdrop-blur-xl, bg-black/60, 1px bright border-white/10). No muddy grey backgrounds.
components.forms: Shadcn based, high contrast. Focus states must have neon glows (focus:ring-primary).
components.navigation: Bottom navigation with Phosphor icons. Active state is an electric yellow underline/glow.
components.header: Crystal Glass sticky header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-white/10)

visual_effects.textures: Heavy noise/grain overlay globally on dark sections.
visual_effects.decorations: Massive kinetic marquee text in backgrounds (outline text, text-8xl+, react-fast-marquee).
visual_effects.animations: Framer motion staggered entrances, hover scale-up on bento grid items, parallax scrolling with Lenis.
visual_effects.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/5 for dark mode containers with 1px border-white/10.

media.description: Vibrant urban alley illuminated by neon signs
Dark cinematic infrared lighting with velvet red abstract patterns

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: APCA contrast calculator used. Text shadow required over complex images.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include 'data-testid' in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural/hero layouts, Shadcn for interactive logic.
Embrace asymmetry. The UI should feel like a high-end streetwear magazine drop, mixing raw brutalist components with refined glassmorphism.
Implement 'DeeplyUs' mode by overriding the theme colors completely (shift from dark/neon to deep crimson/infrared).
Include 'data-testid' attributes extensively on all interactable elements and major content blocks.
DO NOT center everything. Use strong left alignment and tension in layouts.
Images MUST not exceed 80vh on mobile.
